create.name: Jai Uttal
create.bio:
Jai Uttal is a kirtan leader, composer and multi-instrumentalist who has taught devotional chanting for around fifty years. Raised in New York City, he studied classical piano as a child and later banjo and guitar. At seventeen he heard Indian classical music for the first time and went on to study in California with the sarod master Ali Akbar Khan. In 1971 he met his guru, Neem Karoli Baba, in India, and he spent long periods there among the Baul street singers of Bengal and the kirtan singers of his guru's temple. He has released more than twenty albums blending Indian devotional music with rock, jazz and folk, and was nominated for a Grammy.

He regards Bhakti Yoga, the yoga of devotion, as the centre of his music and spiritual life. His teaching treats kirtan as a practice open to everyone, whatever their voice: call-and-response chanting of sacred names, simple mantra melodies, harmonium and guitar, silence, and stories from the Indian devotional tradition. He leads chanting evenings in California, week-long Kirtan Camp retreats in Costa Rica and a year-long online kirtan training, and teaches live courses on The Shift Network.

courses.title: Sing Your Heart Into Surrender With Kirtan
courses.description: A seven-week live online course with Jai on The Shift Network, using kirtan, mantra and deep listening to turn the voice into a devotional practice. No singing experience is needed, and every class is recorded.

courses.title: The Art & Practice of Kirtan: A 365-Day Journey of Bhakti
courses.description: Jai's year-long online kirtan training, with three progressive courses, six live online sessions and a practice community. It covers chanting, mantra melodies and accompaniment, with access to the materials for two years.

courses.title: Summer Kirtan Camp with Jai Uttal & Friends
courses.description: A week-long residential kirtan retreat at Blue Spirit in Nosara, Costa Rica, with daily chanting and teaching on the practices of kirtan and bhakti. Guest teachers are Nubia Teixeira and Visvambhar Sheth.

courses.title: Ecstatic Chant
courses.description: A seven-day New Year chanting retreat at Blue Spirit in Costa Rica, led by Jai with Deva Premal & Miten, Jahnavi Harrison and Marianela Ortiz. Days include chanting sessions and movement classes.

courses.title: Jai Uttal on Patreon
courses.description: A monthly membership with Jai's posts on world spirit music, kirtan and bhakti yoga. Members get access to more than 800 posts.
